breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Tarsal tunnel syndrome is a nerve disorder that is characterized by pain in the ankle, foot, and toes. This condition is caused by compression of the posterior tibial nerve, which runs through a canal near the heel into the sole of the foot. When tissues around this nerve become inflamed, they can press on the nerve and cause the pain associated with tarsal tunnel syndrome.
synonyms_en: neuropathy of the posterior tibial nerve and its branches

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。

master.definition_en: Human pneumocystosis is caused by an infectious agent, which (after recent nomenclature and taxonomy revisions) is now classed as the fungus Pneumocystis jiroveci. The prevalence is unknown. Pneumocystis jiroveci is an opportunistic infectious agent, developing in immunosuppressed patients. It is an air-borne infection, localized to the lungs. However, extrapulmonary involvement is seen in AIDS patients. The disease manifests progressively with coughing, respiratory problems (dyspnea) and fever, followed by acute respiratory insufficiency and death within a few weeks in untreated cases. The most reliable diagnostic method is bronchoalveolar lavage. The treatment of choice is cotrimoxazole.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 免疫受损人群（如未经规范抗病毒治疗的HIV感染者、肿瘤放化疗、器官移植或长期服用激素/免疫抑制剂的肾病与风湿病患者）极其凶险的机会性肺炎！起病隐匿但一旦出现呼吸困难，低氧血症呈进行性恶化，数日至1–2周内即可因重度ARDS呼吸衰竭死亡，非HIV患者病死率尤为高企（可达30%–50%）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 复方磺胺甲噁唑（TMP-SMX）是绝对一线特效药（联合早期糖皮质激素用于低氧血症重症），及时足量用药多数患者可治愈；高危免疫抑制人群规律低剂量预防用药可几乎完全避免发病。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Denning（Lancet Infectious Diseases 2024）估算全球每年约50.5万例PCP发病，造成约21.4万例死亡（病死率约42.4%）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列PCP独立年度死亡人数；近年来随着糖皮质激素、生物制剂及靶向抗肿瘤药广泛应用，中国非HIV免疫抑制人群PCP占比与ICU病死率显著攀升。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球年发病约505,000例，见于CD4+<200/μL的HIV患者及各类非HIV免疫抑制人群。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: HIV感染者及肾移植、风湿免疫病、血液肿瘤患者中常见，部分三甲医院非HIV相关PCP已超过HIV相关PCP。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：长期使用激素/免疫抑制剂、肿瘤放化疗或HIV人群，若出现干咳、活动后明显气促憋气、低热，指脉氧饱和度（SpO2）低于93%或静息即呼吸困难（“白肺”磨玻璃影进展极快），立即拨打120或急诊抢救！严禁当普通细菌性肺炎只用头孢/青霉素（对肺孢子菌无效！）而延误救治；急诊立即高流量吸氧/无创通气，抢先启用大剂量复方磺胺甲噁唑（TMP-SMX）并针对低氧血症（PaO2<70 mmHg）尽早联合糖皮质激素抗炎防肺损伤。

master.definition_en: Kommerell diverticulum (KD) is a developmental anomaly of the aortic arch characterized by a diverticulum at the proximal descending aorta of left or right arch configuration that gives rise to an aberrant subclavian artery. KD is primarily asymptomatic but may become symptomatic secondary to dilatation of KD, atheroma and fibrotic changes in paratracheal or paraesophageal tissue, presenting with signs of tracheal compression (more common in children), esophageal compression (dysphagia lusoria; more common in patients with a right sided aortic arch), chest pain, or blood pressure difference in the upper limbs. KD may also predispose toward aortic dissection or rupture.

master.definition_en: Any immunodeficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the FNIP1 gene, characterized by onset of recurrent viral and bacterial infections, particularly with encapsulated bacteria, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in the first months or years of life. Immunologic workup typically shows decreased circulating B cells and hypo- or agammaglobulinemia, sometimes with neutropenia or T-cell lymphocytosis, although laboratory findings may be variable among patients. Ig replacement therapy is beneficial. Cardiac involvement can also include atrial septal defect, valvular insufficiency, and pre-excitation syndrome. Rare myopathic or neurologic involvement has been reported, but these features are not consistently part of the disorder and may be related to other genetic defects. Disruption of Folliculin Interacting Protein 1 alters the essential metabolic regulators AMPK and mTOR, resulting in profound B-cell deficiency, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and pre-excitation syndrome.
